synthesis:draft.headline: Definition of operational demand
summary: Operational demand in a region is demand that is met by local scheduled, semi-scheduled and significant non-scheduled generation, by generation from scheduled bidirectional units, and by generation imports to the region, excluding the demand of local scheduled loads and scheduled bidirectional units, and including Wholesale Demand Response. [aemo_demand_terms#p9c11]

Operational demand generally excludes demand met by non-scheduled wind/solar generation of aggregate capacity < 30 MW, non-scheduled non-wind/non-solar generation and exempt generation. [aemo_demand_terms#p10c14]

Actual operational demand includes the measured operational demand reconstituted with estimated actual Wholesale Demand Response (WDR); when WDR is dispatched the measured operational demand decreases by the amount of dispatched WDR. [aemo_demand_terms#p10c15]
